Let me write a test program to confirm.","role":"assistant","tool_calls":[{"function":{"arguments":"{"command":"cd /redis && cat > /tmp/test_fpconv.c << 'EOF'\n#include <stdio.h>\n#include \"deps/fpconv/fpconv_dtoa.h\"\n\nint main() {\n    char buf[24];\n    double values[] = {\n        1000000000.0,   /* 1e9 */\n        1050000000.0,\n        1100000000.0,   /* 1.1e9 */\n        1150000000.0,\n        1200000000.0,   /* 1.2e9 */\n        1250000000.0,\n        1300000000.0,\n        2000000000.0,\n        100000000.0,    /* 1e8 */\n        10000000.0,     /* 1e7 */\n        10000000000.0,  /* 1e10 */\n        100000000000.0, /* 1e11 */\n        123456789.0,\n        0.0,\n        1.5,\n        123456789012345.0,\n    };\n    int n = sizeof(values)/sizeof(values[0]);\n    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n        int len = fpconv_dtoa(values[i], buf);\n        buf[len] = '\\0';\n        printf(\"%20.1f -> '%s' (len=%d)\\n\", values[i], buf, len);\n    }\n    return 0;\n}\nEOF\ngcc -I. /tmp/test_fpconv.c deps/fpconv/fpconv_dtoa.c -lm -o /tmp/test_fpconv && /tmp/test_fpconv"}","name":"bash"},"id":"call_-7373319409588237181","index":0,"type":"function"}]}}],"created":1786052636,"id":"202608070543503b63361bd92a46bc","model":"glm-5.2","object":"chat.completion","request_id":"202608070543503b63361bd92a46bc","usage":{"completion_tokens":690,"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":216},"prompt_tokens":21500,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":20800},"total_tokens":22190}}
